column1: # MMGEN in-silico PCR demo panel. Sequences 5'->3'; IUPAC codes allowed.
# CDC_N1, CDC_N2: US CDC 2019-nCoV real-time RT-PCR panel, Table 1 of
#   Lu X, Wang L, Sakthivel SK, et al. US CDC real-time reverse transcription
#   PCR panel for detection of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2.
#   (sequences read from https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/26/8/20-1246-t1 on
#   2026-11-14; the same as the CDC "Research Use Only 2019-nCoV Real-time
#   RT-PCR Primers and Probes" page). On NC_045512.2 the products are
#   28287-28358 (N1) and 29164-29230 (N2): checked by this tool, 0 mismatches.
# 16S_V4: 515F-Y (Parada AE, Needham DM, Fuhrman JA. Environ Microbiol
#   2016;18:1403-1414) and 806RB (Apprill A, McNally S, Parsons R, Weber L.
#   Aquat Microb Ecol 2015;75:129-137), the Earth Microbiome Project pair; the
#   original 515F/806R are Caporaso JG et al. PNAS 2011;108 Suppl 1:4516-4522.
# 16S_full: 27F and 1492R (Lane DJ. 16S/23S rRNA sequencing. In: Stackebrandt
#   E, Goodfellow M, eds. Nucleic Acid Techniques in Bacterial Systematics.
#   Wiley, 1991:115-175), in their usual degenerate forms.
# mecA: MR1/MR2 of Murakami K, Minamide W, Wada K, Nakamura E, Teraoka H,
#   Watanabe S. Identification of methicillin-resistant strains of
#   staphylococci by polymerase chain reaction. J Clin Microbiol
#   1991;29(10):2240-2244 (533-bp product); sequences as reproduced by later
#   users of the assay, and checked here: 533 bp, 0 mismatches, in the mecA
#   of S. aureus N315.
